links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading grade level of LLM-generated patient leaflets versus society leaflet
links.effect: GPT-4 grade ≈ 6.6, Gemini ≈ 7.4; Sonnet4 ≈ 15; Llama-4 ≈ 17; IUGA leaflets around 9-10.
links.quote: Readability varied greatly: GPT-4 had an average Flesch-Kincaid grade level ≈ 6.6, Gemini ≈ 7.4; Sonnet4 ≈ 15; Llama-4 ≈ 17.

links.outcome: Understandability (PEMAT-U) and readability of AI-generated patient education materials
links.effect: PEMAT-U showed a trend (p = 0.063); Sonnet4 outperformed Llama-4 on PEMAT-U; readability grade levels ranged from ≈6.6 to ≈17.

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality, understandability, actionability, and readability of patient education materials generated by various commercial LLMs compared to established medical society leaflets via blinded clinician review.
